newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,290 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,290 contracts.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totalled 1,290 contracts compared with 760 overnight Monday, according to the CBOT.
There were 163 wheat, 454 corn, 455 soybean, 128 soymeal, 60 soyoil, one wheat option and 29 soybean options traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was one to three cents higher, corn was one to 1-1/2 cents higher and soybeans were 1/2 to two cents higher.
